name: Claude Code
description: Claude Code as a chat agent: CLI models and slash commands, compact/rewind/fork/export, context and cost meter, subagents, hooks, plugins, skills, permission rules and profiles — with allow/deny for every action. Ships executable code.
author: Lumen

settings.label: Path to claude
settings.hint: Leave empty to find claude on the PATH and in the usual folders (~/.local/bin, ~/.claude/local …).

settings.label: Default model
settings.hint: Applies while "Default" is chosen in the chat — e.g. opus, sonnet or claude-opus-5-5. The chat picker is loaded by Claude Code itself.

settings.label: Fallback model
settings.hint: Used when the selected model is overloaded.

settings.label: Offer older models
settings.hint: Adds older models to the model picker that Claude Code itself no longer lists (Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.1 …). Whether a model still answers for your account is up to Anthropic.

settings.label: More models
settings.hint: In addition to the Claude Code list — one model ID per line, optionally with "| Display name".

settings.label: Cache model list (minutes)
settings.hint: How long the Claude Code list is reused. The button next to the model picker reloads it immediately.

settings.label: Default effort
settings.hint: Applies while no effort is chosen in the chat. In the chat it can be set per model — only the levels the model supports are offered.

settings.label: Fast mode
settings.hint: Faster output on models that support it (costs more).

settings.label: Stream answers live
settings.hint: Shows text and reasoning while Claude writes.

settings.label: Maximum steps
settings.hint: Aborts an answer after this many tool rounds.

settings.label: Additional instructions
settings.placeholder: Answer in English. Prefer small changes …
settings.hint: Appended to the Claude Code system prompt — in addition to CLAUDE.md.

settings.label: Output style
settings.hint: Name of an output style, e.g. Explanatory or Learning.

settings.label: Save sessions
settings.hint: Off: conversations are not stored in ~/.claude and cannot be resumed later.

settings.label: Back up files for rewind
settings.hint: Claude copies files before changing them, so "Rewind" in the chat's menu can restore them.

settings.label: Tools allowed without asking
settings.hint: One rule per line, as in the Claude Code settings.

settings.label: Denied tools
settings.hint: One rule per line. Denied tools are not available to Claude at all.

settings.label: Tools that always ask
settings.hint: One rule per line. These ask even in modes that would allow them (permission rules "ask").

settings.label: Built-in tools
settings.hint: Which of Claude Code's own tools exist at all. Read-only leaves Claude without Edit, Write and Bash.

settings.label: Tool list
settings.hint: One tool name per line.

settings.label: Sandbox
settings.hint: Runs Bash in Claude Code's sandbox (where the platform supports it).

choices.label: On, run sandboxed commands without asking

settings.label: More folders
settings.hint: Folders outside the project that Claude may access — one per line.

settings.label: Allow "No prompts" mode
settings.hint: Warning: in this mode Claude runs every command and change without asking. Use only in isolated environments.

settings.label: Subagents
settings.placeholder: reviewer | Reviews code for bugs | You are a strict code reviewer. Report problems by severity. | Read,Grep,Glob | sonnet
settings.hint: One per line: name | description | prompt | tools | model. Tools comma-separated (empty: all), model an alias like sonnet (empty: inherit), \n in the prompt is a line break. JSON like --agents works too. Used through the Task tool, shown nested in the chat.

settings.label: Plugins
settings.hint: Folders of local Claude Code plugins (skills, commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers), one per line.

settings.label: Skills
settings.hint: Empty: as Claude Code loads them. "all", or the names to load, one per line.

settings.label: Only the MCP servers listed here
settings.hint: Ignores .mcp.json, user settings and plugins for MCP servers (--strict-mcp-config); only "Additional MCP servers" apply. /mcp in the chat shows their state.

settings.label: Hooks
settings.hint: One per line: Event | matcher | shell command. Events: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStop, SessionStart, Notification, PreCompact. Matcher: tool name or regex (empty = all). Event JSON arrives on stdin; exit code 2 blocks (stderr is the reason) and is shown in the chat. Hooks of .claude/settings.json run too.

settings.label: Additional MCP servers (JSON)
settings.hint: Like "mcpServers" in .mcp.json. The servers from the Claude Code settings apply anyway.

settings.label: Beta features
settings.hint: Beta headers (--betas), one per line. Only for API-key accounts.

settings.label: Environment variables
settings.hint: KEY=VALUE, one per line.

settings.label: Quick actions
settings.default:
Explain selection | Explain what this code does and why:

{{selection}}
Fix problems in file | Find and fix the problems in {{file}}. Check the diagnostics first and keep the changes minimal.
Write tests | Write tests for {{file}} (focus on this selection if there is one):

{{selection}}

Match the project's test style and run them.
Review diff | Review my uncommitted changes (git diff). Report bugs, risks and unclear code by severity.
Commit message | Look at the staged changes (git diff --staged) and write a concise commit message. Do not commit.
settings.hint: Buttons above the message box, one per line: Label | prompt. {{selection}}, {{file}} and {{clipboard}} are filled in; \n is a line break; lines starting with # are ignored.

settings.label: Commands
settings.default:
review | Review the uncommitted changes | Review the current changes (git diff) for bugs, missing tests and unclear names. Extra focus: $ARGUMENTS
explain | Explain a file or topic | Explain $ARGUMENTS in this project. Without an argument, explain {{file}}.
tests | Write tests | Write tests for $ARGUMENTS (without an argument: for {{file}}). Match the project's test style and run them.
plan | Plan without changing anything | Make a step-by-step plan for: $ARGUMENTS. Read what you need, but change nothing.
remember | Add a note to CLAUDE.md | Add the following to the project's CLAUDE.md (create it if missing), short and in the file's existing style: $ARGUMENTS
memory | Summarize the loaded CLAUDE.md files | List the instructions from every CLAUDE.md you have loaded (user and project), grouped by file.
settings.hint: Slash commands of your own, one per line: name | description | prompt. $ARGUMENTS (or {{args}}) is what follows the command; {{selection}}, {{file}} and {{clipboard}} work too. Claude Code's own commands and those from .claude/commands appear next to them.

settings.label: Profiles
settings.default:
Plan (Opus, high) | mode=plan | model=opus | effort=high
Quick edit (Sonnet) | mode=acceptEdits | model=sonnet | effort=low
Read-only review | mode=plan | model=sonnet | effort=medium | toolset=readonly
Sandboxed autonomy | mode=acceptEdits | sandbox=on-auto
settings.hint: One choice sets mode, model, effort and any extra setting of this extension by its key (toolset=readonly, sandbox=on, thinking=adaptive …) together. One per line: Label | key=value | …

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.description: Ask Claude about your project: explain code, find bugs, make changes. Every action asks for your permission first. Compact, rewind, fork and export conversations; subagents, hooks, plugins and skills.
agents.placeholder: Message Claude …  (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line, / commands, @ files)

modes.label: Ask
modes.description: Asks before every change and command

modes.label: Auto-accept edits
modes.description: File changes without asking, commands still ask first

modes.label: Only allowed
modes.description: Never asks: whatever the allow rules do not cover is denied

modes.label: No prompts
modes.description: Runs everything without asking — must be enabled in the settings

suggestions: Explain the structure of this project.
Find possible bugs in the open file.
Write tests for the current selection.
